t: Magnusson extra-fine 320 grit hand sanding sheets are designed for manual prep work, offering a sharp cutting action to achieve smooth surfaces with a professional finish. The pack of 4 sheets is ideal for decorators and joiners preparing wood and metal surfaces before painting or varnishing. Constructed from sharp silicon carbide abrasive on a durable, water-resistant latex paper backing, the sheets perform exceptionally well for both wet and dry applications. The 280 x 230mm size ensures wide coverage and efficient material removal, providing a high-quality, professional finish.
